governance.standards_body: Indian Council of Agricultural Research & CIBRC

rules.name: Tomato Early Blight Foliar Moisture Risk
rules.description: Evaluates fungal Alternaria spore acceleration when foliar yellowing/spots coincide with recent rainfall.
rules.recommendation: Recent rainfall accelerates Alternaria spore splash. Prune lower diseased foliage, improve drainage, and apply biological Trichoderma viride or protective copper/mancozeb as per CIBRC label.

rules.name: Tomato High Heat Transpiration Stress
rules.description: Detects high temperature moisture depletion causing temporary wilting or leaf curl.
rules.recommendation: Ambient thermal stress detected. Apply drip irrigation in evening hours and use straw/plastic mulch around root zone to retain soil moisture.

rules.name: Wheat Crown Root Initiation Critical Irrigation
rules.description: Flags critical 20-25 days after sowing window where water stress severely penalizes tillering.
rules.recommendation: Crown Root Initiation (20-25 DAS) is the most critical irrigation stage for wheat. Apply first irrigation immediately if field has not received rain.

rules.name: Post-Rain Drainage and Root Rot Prevention
rules.description: Triggers immediate field drainage advisory following heavy precipitation to prevent root asphyxiation.
rules.recommendation: Drain standing water within 12-24 hours to prevent anoxic root collapse and soil-borne damping-off fungi. Defer foliar chemical sprays until surface dries.

rules.name: Tomato Viral Vector Monitoring
rules.description: Directs whitefly monitoring and early rogueing upon leaf curling or stunting symptoms.
rules.recommendation: Tomato leaf curl is vectored by whiteflies. Install bright yellow sticky traps (15-20/acre) and rogue out severely curled young plants early.
